jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you will manage the full recruitment cycle while building strong relationships with both clients and candidates. You will combine business development, consulting, and talent acquisition to deliver successful recruitment solutions.

Client Details

Michael Page is a global leader in specialized recruitment, connecting top talent with leading companies across a wide range of industries. With a strong international presence and a people-focused culture, Michael Page offers a dynamic environment where ambition and career growth are encouraged.

Description

• Manage the end-to-end recruitment process.
• Develop and maintain a portfolio of clients.
• Source, interview, and assess qualified candidates.
• Build long-term relationships with clients and candidates.
• Provide recruitment advice and market insights.
• Negotiate offers and support placements.
• Contribute to business growth through commercial activities.

• Previous experience in sales, business development, customer-facing roles, or recruitment is a strong advantage.
• Commercial mindset with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Driven, resilient, and target-oriented.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• Fluent in French & Dutch, French & English, or Dutch & English.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international, and performance-driven environment.

What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?
 

 
• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations
 
• Secure containers with cover nets or tarps to ensure safe transport
 
• Alternate between driving and manual work on-site
 
• Respond to customer questions in a friendly and professional manner 

What are we looking for in a Driver C/CE with Hooklift Experience?
 

 
• Driving licence C or CE; only C but motivated to drive with a trailer? CE can be obtained internally
 
• Experience as a driver is an advantage but not required
 
• You are an early starter (between 4 a.m. and 6 a.m.)
 
• You speak Dutch, English or French for safety instructions

For our client, an international organization in Heverlee , we are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead the AP team. In this key role, you will ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, maintain compliance with accounting and tax regulations and drive continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead, coach, and develop the Accounts Payable team.

• Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.

• Coordinate invoice processing, payment runs, and AP-related financial controls.

• Manage monthly closing activities, reconciliations, accruals, and follow-up of outstanding items.

• Ensure compliance with VAT, tax, and internal accounting policies.

• Act as the main point of contact for AP-related matters across multiple stakeholders.

• Identify and implement process improvements, standardization initiatives, and automation opportunities.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent through experience.

• Several years of experience in Accounts Payable within a multinational or complex organization.

• Strong SAP knowledge; experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• Solid understanding of VAT and accounting regulations.

• Proven experience leading and developing teams.

• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
The Commercial Coordinator role within the FMCG industry focuses on supporting sales, logistics, customer service operations in the beer sector. This position requires organisational skills to manage customer interactions and ensure smooth process optimizations.

Client Details

Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Description

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.

 

Concretely you will:

 

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process
 

 

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

jobs.occupation: Senior Executive Assistant - International law firm (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Our client is an international law firm based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide high-level administrative support to senior professionals, including complex calendar management, correspondence handling, preparation of presentations, and phone support.
• Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including transportation, accommodation, meeting logistics, and expense management.
• Organize and coordinate meetings, conferences, networking events, and client-related activities.
• Manage and maintain electronic and paper records, ensuring accurate filing and document management.
• Handle extensive email management, prioritizing communications and responding to requests when appropriate.
• Support the billing process, including the preparation, review, and follow-up of invoices.
• Prepare and process a significant volume of complex billing activities, requiring accuracy, attention to detail, and strong analytical skills.
• Maintain databases, contact lists, and administrative records.
• Provide ad hoc administrative support and assist with various projects as required.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or Senior Administrative Assistant role.
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English (spoken and written). Trilingual proficiency is essential.
• Excellent command of the Microsoft Office Suite.
• Advanced knowledge of Excel is required, including the ability to work with complex spreadsheets, data management, reporting, and billing-related tasks.
• Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with stakeholders at all levels.
• Able to remain calm under pressure and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, flexible, and service-oriented team player.

Additional RequirementGiven the volume and complexity of the invoicing responsibilities, our client is specifically seeking someone with strong billing experience and the ability to manage complex invoicing processes efficiently and accurately.

We are looking for an experienced and motivated crane operator to join our team. You will work in a 2-shift system and handle heavy loads safely and efficiently.

Your tasks:

• 
Operate overhead cranes and semi-portal cranes (up to 25 tons)

• 
Perform visual inspections and basic maintenance

• 
Follow safety rules at all times

• 
Work closely with your team to move materials

• 
Keep records of movements and incidents

Your profile:

• 
Experience with cranes, forklifts, or tower cranes

• 
A valid certificate is a plus (can also be obtained internally)

• 
Good technical skills and understanding of safety rules

• 
Willing to work in two shifts (early: 5:00-13:15 / late: 13:15-21:30)

• 
Team player, flexible, precise, and stress-resistant

• 
Good understanding of balance and load distribution

• 
Good Dutch or English skills

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

What are your responsibilities?

• As a packer, you will slice and package ham
• Work in cold/cool temperatures
• You will work in the Oudenaarde area
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

We are looking for an experienced auto body technician for a company specializing in cars.

What are your tasks?

- You repair and replace damaged bodywork and car parts on vehicles.

- You carry out sheet metal and welding work.

- You will align and assemble parts.

- You will prepare surfaces and ensure a neat finish before spraying, so that the vehicle is safe and aesthetically pleasing again.

Working hours:

Monday to Thursday: 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.

What do we expect from you?

- You speak Dutch or English

- You have one year of experience as a bodywork technician or in a garage

- You have your own car (a bicycle is also possible if you live nearby)

We are looking for an experienced seamstress/seamster for a mattress manufacturing company in the Maldegem region!

What will your tasks be?

• You will be responsible for sewing covers and closing the mattresses.
As you gain more experience, we will teach you additional tasks step by step, such as:

• inserting zippers
• sewing on ribbons
• other finishing details

What do we expect from you? 

• You work accurately and contribute to a high-quality end product.
• You already have some experience with sewing or working on a sewing machine.
• You work precisely and are quality-oriented.
• You speak Dutch or English well!
• The job is mainly done standing up, so you must be physically able to do this.

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:
As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

As a production worker, you will join a food manufacturing company where you will assist in the meat smoking production process. Your responsibilities include loading the products into the smoking machine, operating the machine, and placing the finished products back onto the correct racks after processing. At the end of each working day, you will also be responsible for cleaning the work area and the equipment.

You will work from Monday untill Friday from 5:15 until the work is done (about 13h or 13h30). You will work 38h a week.

The salary for this position is €17.45 per hour, plus a shift allowance.

We are looking for people who speak basic English and Polish.

• You have knowledge of basic Polish and basis English
• You can work from 5h15 in the morning
• You are willing to work in food industry

We are looking for an enthusiastic CNC miller for our production department. Our client develops and manufactures modular systems for the live communications sector. As a CNC miller, you will mill aluminum profiles according to drawings. You will alternate between batch production and custom work. In addition, you will use an ERP system to process production orders. You will also be responsible for creating milling programs, setting up the milling machine, loading and unloading the machine, and performing quality checks. Furthermore, you will perform first-line maintenance on the machine. 

• Experience as a CNC miller
• Ability to read blueprints and knowledge of using measuring instruments
• Quality-oriented, with a sense of order and neatness
• You are fluent in English
• Willing to work in a two-shift system
• Team player with a positive attitude

About Fluves
 

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber optic sensing and subsea cable monitoring services. Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves delivers world-leading subsea cable integrity monitoring solutions to offshore wind operators worldwide by combining real-time data, advanced DTS & DAS technology, and smart analytics. Currently, Marlinks monitors over 1800km of power cables across the globe.
 

Your role
 

As Sales Manager at Fluves, you will be the commercial driver for the continued international growth of our Marlinks cable monitoring solutions. Your mission is to convert technical excellence into long-term customer relationships and revenue. You will work closely with our delivery, portfolio and development teams to bring the Marlinks product suite to the world’s leading offshore wind operators, utilities, and developers.
 

 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Own and drive the full sales cycle: from lead qualification and proposal development to contract negotiation and closing (for new and existing accounts) in the offshore wind sector. 

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of international prospects across Europe, Americas, and Asia-Pacific, with a focus on developers, cable owners, operators, and EPC contractors. 

• Represent Fluves and the Marlinks product line at industry conferences and events (e.g. WindEurope, Global Offshore Wind, offshore energy summits), strengthening our brand and expanding our network. 

• Collaborate on the development and execution of territory plans, set ambitious sales targets, and report pipeline progress and market intelligence to the Head of Marketing & Sales Team. 

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, translating market feedback into product and service improvements in close collaboration with engineering and product teams. 

Who you are
 

You bring a combination of commercial drive, technical curiosity, and strong interpersonal skills. You:
 
 

• Have 5–10 years of B2B sales experience, ideally in offshore energy, cleantech, industrial monitoring, or related deep-tech sectors. 

• Are comfortable selling complex, technical solutions and can translate fiber optic monitoring into tangible business value for engineers, asset managers, and executives. 

• Are proactive, self-driven, and energized by building new markets from the ground up — you are a hunter and a builder. 

• Have strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to represent Fluves and the Marlinks product line confidently at senior levels and major international events. 

• Are willing to travel internationally (10-15%), to key markets in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. 

• Are fluent in English. Additional languages are a strong asset.

Are you a tech-savvy, handy person?

Can you easily take on a variety of tasks?

Do you also love potatoes?

Then we have the job for you!

We’re looking for a motivated Logistics Operator for a company that specializes in potato processing!

What will your responsibilities be?

• You’ll keep track of the actions taken for inventory management
• You resolve technical malfunctions in the automated cold storage facility
• You assist your coworkers with loading and unloading trucks

What do we expect from you?

• Some familiarity with computers
• No fear of heights
• No aversion to working in a colder environment
• You have a good command of Dutch, English, OR French!
• You will be working in a two-shift rotation or in the night
